description: This file defines an interface for a storage management component within the WPEFramework. It declares the IStorageManager interface with methods to create, retrieve, delete, and clear storage associated with applications, using virtual functions and handling external resources. It also includes licensing information and namespace organization.

classes.name: IStorageManager
classes.description: An abstract interface for managing application storage, providing methods to create, retrieve, delete, and clear storage resources.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates storage for a specified application ID, returning the storage path or an error reason.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves storage location details for a specified application ID, including path, size, and used space.

methods.name: DeleteStorage
methods.description: Deletes storage associated with a specified application ID.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all storage data for a specified application ID, potentially also affecting device storage.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears storage data for all applications except for specified exempt app IDs, used for bulk cleanup.
